name: Suzuki Moe
source:
A mature Japanese woman who loves Japanese culture. 

[Spoiler]Sickness:

Phallophilia: An intense sexual attraction to big penises. 

After being betrayed, she could no longer trust people.

Having both the fear of being touched and an intense attraction to penises made her incredibly lonely, and she decided to commit suicide.[/spoiler]

[Based on the in-game profile]

[spoiler]Her real name is Celestiano Perstin (セレスティアーノ・ペルスティン), the short form is Erstin (エルスティン).[/spoiler]
